slides.headline: Why it matters
bullet_points: What is the total cost, including all fees?
Is the rate fixed or variable?
What security or guarantees are required?
What happens if I want to repay early?

caption:
Comparing lenders becomes much easier when you ask the same core questions of each one, total cost, rate type, security requirements, and what happens if things change.

Treat this as a standard checklist for every finance decision, not just this one.
